qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Distribution advantage via exclusive bancassurance agreement with BNP Paribas Fortis in Belgium, but lacks pricing power: UK personal lines are aggregator-driven price-taking operations, and Asian growth relies on non-controlled minority joint ventures. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC fails the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Pricing Power & Proof of Moat, REJECT). Belgian bancassurance leader depends heavily on third-party banking partner BNP Paribas Fortis for distribution, while Asian operations are minority JVs and UK general insurance is an aggregator-driven price-taker. Lacks structural pricing power above claims inflation, with multi-cycle GAAP ROIC falling short of the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: AG Insurance holds ~30% Belgian life and ~20% non-life share via BNP Paribas Fortis branches, but contract renewal risk and partner dependence limit economic rent extraction. In the UK, personal motor lines face brutal aggregator competition. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC fails the 12% hurdle.
